questions.stem: Which of the following oxoacids of phosphorus contains a $\mathrm{P}-\mathrm{P}$ single bond?
questions.solution: Hypophosphoric acid ($\mathrm{H_4P_2O_6}$) has the structure $(\mathrm{HO})_2\mathrm{P}(=\mathrm{O})-\mathrm{P}(=\mathrm{O})(\mathrm{OH})_2$, which contains a direct $\mathrm{P}-\mathrm{P}$ single bond. Pyrophosphoric acid ($\mathrm{H_4P_2O_7}$) contains a $\mathrm{P}-\mathrm{O}-\mathrm{P}$ linkage.

questions.stem:
Among the following compounds, the number of compounds containing at least one $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ linkage is ____________.
- $\mathrm{H_4P_2O_5}$
- $\mathrm{H_4P_2O_6}$
- $\mathrm{H_4P_2O_7}$
- $\mathrm{H_5P_3O_{10}}$
- $(\mathrm{HPO_3})_3$
questions.solution:
- $\mathrm{H_4P_2O_5}$ (pyrophosphorous acid): has a $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ linkage.
- $\mathrm{H_4P_2O_6}$ (hypophosphoric acid): has a $\mathrm{P-P}$ bond, no $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ linkage.
- $\mathrm{H_4P_2O_7}$ (pyrophosphoric acid): has a $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ linkage.
- $\mathrm{H_5P_3O_{10}}$ (triphosphoric acid): has two $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ linkages.
- $(\mathrm{HPO_3})_3$ (cyclotrimetaphosphoric acid): cyclic structure with three $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ linkages.
Therefore, 4 compounds contain at least one $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ linkage.

questions.stem: The incorrect statement among the following is:

options.label: A
options.content: $\mathrm{N}_2$ has higher bond dissociation enthalpy than $\mathrm{P}_2$.

options.label: B
options.content: $\mathrm{N}-\mathrm{N}$ single bond is stronger than $\mathrm{P}-\mathrm{P}$ single bond.

options.label: C
options.content: Nitrogen does not form pentahalides due to non-availability of d-orbitals.

options.label: D
options.content: Nitrogen is inert at room temperature due to high bond enthalpy of $\mathrm{N}\equiv\mathrm{N}$.

questions.solution: The $\mathrm{N}-\mathrm{N}$ single bond is weaker than the $\mathrm{P}-\mathrm{P}$ single bond due to high inter-electronic repulsion between the non-bonding valence electrons of small nitrogen atoms. Thus, statement B is incorrect.

questions.stem:
Among the following, the number of compounds that contain a $\mathrm{P-P}$ bond is __________.
$\mathrm{H_4P_2O_5}$, $\mathrm{H_4P_2O_6}$, $\mathrm{H_4P_2O_7}$, $(\mathrm{HPO_3})_3$
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{H_4P_2O_5}$ (Pyrophosphorous acid) has $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ bond.
$\mathrm{H_4P_2O_6}$ (Hypophosphoric acid) has a $\mathrm{P-P}$ bond.
$\mathrm{H_4P_2O_7}$ (Pyrophosphoric acid) has a $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ bond.
$(\mathrm{HPO_3})_3$ (Cyclotrimetaphosphoric acid) is a cyclic trimer with $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ bonds.
Therefore, only 1 compound contains a $\mathrm{P-P}$ bond.

questions.stem: The correct order of reducing character of group 15 hydrides is:
questions.solution: Down the group, thermal stability of the hydrides decreases due to an increase in $M-H$ bond length (decrease in bond dissociation enthalpy). Consequently, the reducing character increases down the group: $\mathrm{NH}_3 < \mathrm{PH}_3 < \mathrm{AsH}_3 < \mathrm{SbH}_3 < \mathrm{BiH}_3$.

questions.stem: Which of the following oxoacids of phosphorus has a P-P bond?
questions.solution: Hypophosphoric acid ($\mathrm{H_4P_2O_6}$) has the structure $(\mathrm{HO})_2\mathrm{P}(=\mathrm{O})-\mathrm{P}(=\mathrm{O})(\mathrm{OH})_2$, which contains a direct $\mathrm{P-P}$ bond. Pyrophosphoric acid ($\mathrm{H_4P_2O_7}$) contains a $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ bond.

questions.stem: In the structural formula of pyrophosphoric acid, the number of $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ bonds, $\mathrm{P=O}$ bonds, and $\mathrm{P-OH}$ bonds are respectively $x$, $y$, and $z$. The value of $x+y+z$ is _________.
questions.solution:
Pyrophosphoric acid is $\mathrm{H_4P_2O_7}$.
Structure contains:
- One $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ bond ($x = 1$)
- Two $\mathrm{P=O}$ bonds ($y = 2$)
- Four $\mathrm{P-OH}$ bonds ($z = 4$)
$x + y + z = 1 + 2 + 4 = 7$.

questions.stem: Which of the following oxoacids of phosphorus contains a $\mathrm{P-P}$ bond?
questions.solution: Hypophosphoric acid, $\mathrm{H_4P_2O_6}$, contains two $\mathrm{P}$ atoms connected directly to each other, forming a $\mathrm{P-P}$ bond where both phosphorus atoms are in the $+4$ oxidation state. Pyrophosphoric acid contains a $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ bond.

questions.stem: Which of the following oxoacids of phosphorus contains P-P single bond?
questions.solution: Hypophosphoric acid ($\mathrm{H}_4\mathrm{P}_2\mathrm{O}_6$) contains a P-P bond, with the structural formula $(\mathrm{HO})_2\mathrm{OP}-\mathrm{PO}(\mathrm{OH})_2$. In contrast, pyrophosphoric acid ($\mathrm{H}_4\mathrm{P}_2\mathrm{O}_7$) contains a P-O-P linkage.

questions.stem: The sum of the number of sigma bonds and pi bonds in pyrophosphoric acid is _________.
questions.solution:
Pyrophosphoric acid is $\mathrm{H_4P_2O_7}$.
Its structure has a $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ bridge, each $\mathrm{P}$ has one $\mathrm{=O}$ bond and two $\mathrm{-OH}$ groups.
Number of single ($\sigma$) bonds: $4\ (\mathrm{O-H}) + 4\ (\mathrm{P-O\ of\ OH}) + 2\ (\mathrm{P-O-P\ bridge}) + 2\ (\sigma\ \text{of } \mathrm{P=O}) = 12\ \sigma$ bonds.
Number of $\pi$ bonds: $2\ (\text{from the two } \mathrm{P=O}\ \text{double bonds}) = 2\ \pi$ bonds.
Sum of $\sigma$ and $\pi$ bonds = $12 + 2 = 14$.

questions.stem: Amongst the following, which phosphorus oxoacid is a reducing agent and contains a $\mathrm{P}-\mathrm{H}$ bond?
questions.solution: Hypophosphorous acid ($\mathrm{H_3PO_2}$) has two $\mathrm{P-H}$ bonds and one $\mathrm{P-OH}$ bond. The presence of $\mathrm{P-H}$ bonds acts as a strong reducing agent. Pyrophosphoric, orthophosphoric, and metaphosphoric acids do not contain $\mathrm{P-H}$ bonds.

questions.stem: The number of bridged oxygen atoms in $\mathrm{P}_4\mathrm{O}_{10}$ is __________.
questions.solution:
In $\mathrm{P}_4\mathrm{O}_{10}$, each of the four phosphorus atoms is at the corner of a tetrahedron.
There are 6 bridging oxygen atoms (P-O-P bonds along the edges of the tetrahedron) and 4 terminal oxygen atoms (P=O bonds at the vertices).
Therefore, the number of bridged oxygen atoms is 6.

questions.stem: Which of the following oxyacids of phosphorus contains a $P-P$ single bond?
questions.solution:
Hypophosphoric acid is $\text{H}_4\text{P}_2\text{O}_6$. Its structure is $(\text{HO})_2\text{P}(=\text{O})-\text{P}(=\text{O})(\text{OH})_2$, which contains a direct $\text{P}-\text{P}$ single bond.
Pyrophosphoric acid ($\text{H}_4\text{P}_2\text{O}_7$) contains a $\text{P}-\text{O}-\text{P}$ linkage.

questions.stem: The sum of number of $\sigma$-bonds and $\pi$-bonds in a molecule of pyrophosphoric acid is _______. (Integer value)
questions.solution:
Pyrophosphoric acid is $\text{H}_4\text{P}_2\text{O}_7$.
Its structure is $(\text{HO})_2\text{P}(=\text{O})-\text{O}-\text{P}(=\text{O})(\text{OH})_2$.
Number of $\sigma$-bonds: $4\text{ (P-OH)} + 2\text{ (P=O)} + 2\text{ (P-O-P)} + 4\text{ (O-H)} = 12$.
Number of $\pi$-bonds: $2\text{ (P=O)} = 2$.
Sum $= 12 + 2 = 14$.

questions.stem: Which of the following oxoacids of phosphorus contains a $P-P$ bond?
questions.solution: Hypophosphoric acid ($\mathrm{H_4P_2O_6}$) contains a direct $\mathrm{P-P}$ bond. Pyrophosphoric acid ($\mathrm{H_4P_2O_7}$) contains a $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ linkage.

questions.stem: The oxidation state of phosphorus in hypophosphoric acid is:
questions.solution:
Hypophosphoric acid is $\text{H}_4\text{P}_2\text{O}_6$.
Let $x$ be the oxidation state of P:
$4(+1) + 2x + 6(-2) = 0 \implies 4 + 2x - 12 = 0 \implies 2x = 8 \implies x = +4$.

questions.stem: Which of the following oxoacids of phosphorus contains a $\mathrm{P-P}$ bond?
questions.solution: Hypophosphoric acid is $\mathrm{H_4P_2O_6}$, which has the structure $(\mathrm{HO})_2\mathrm{P}(=\mathrm{O})-\mathrm{P}(=\mathrm{O})(\mathrm{OH})_2$ containing a direct $\mathrm{P-P}$ bond. Pyrophosphoric acid ($\mathrm{H_4P_2O_7}$) contains a $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ linkage.

questions.stem: The correct order of Lewis acid strength of boron trihalides is:
questions.solution: Due to $p\pi-p\pi$ back-bonding from the filled halogen $p$-orbitals to the vacant $p$-orbital of boron, the electron deficiency of boron decreases. The back-bonding is most effective in $\text{BF}_3$ ($2p-2p$ overlap) and least effective in $\text{BI}_3$ ($2p-5p$ overlap). Thus, $\text{BI}_3$ is the strongest Lewis acid.

questions.stem: Which of the following oxoacids of phosphorus contains a directly bonded $\mathrm{P-P}$ bond?
questions.solution:
Hypophosphoric acid is $\mathrm{H}_4\mathrm{P}_2\mathrm{O}_6$. Its structure contains a $(\mathrm{HO})_2\mathrm{O}\mathrm{P}-\mathrm{P}\mathrm{O}(\mathrm{OH})_2$ linkage which contains a direct $\mathrm{P-P}$ bond.
Pyrophosphoric acid ($\mathrm{H}_4\mathrm{P}_2\mathrm{O}_7$) contains a $\mathrm{P-O-P}$ bond.

questions.stem: The basicity of pyrophosphoric acid is ________.
questions.solution:
Pyrophosphoric acid is $\mathrm{H_4P_2O_7}$.
Its structural formula shows four $-\mathrm{OH}$ groups directly bonded to phosphorus atoms: $(\mathrm{HO})_2\mathrm{P}(=\mathrm{O})-\mathrm{O}-\mathrm{P}(=\mathrm{O})(\mathrm{OH})_2$.
Therefore, all 4 hydrogen atoms are ionizable, and its basicity is 4.

questions.stem: The structural formula of hypophosphorous acid is:
questions.solution: Hypophosphorous acid is $\mathrm{H_3PO_2}$. It contains one $\mathrm{P=O}$, two $\mathrm{P-H}$, and one $\mathrm{P-OH}$ bond, making it a monoprotic acid.

questions.stem: The correct increasing order of basic strength of the hydrides of Group 15 elements is:
questions.solution:
As we move down Group 15, the atomic size increases. The electron density of the lone pair is distributed over a larger volume, making it less available for donation. Thus, the basic strength decreases down the group:
$\mathrm{NH_3 > PH_3 > AsH_3 > SbH_3 > BiH_3}$.

questions.stem: Which of the following oxoacids of phosphorus contains a phosphorus-phosphorus ($\mathrm{P-P}$) single bond?
questions.solution: Hypophosphoric acid ($\mathrm{H_4P_2O_6}$) contains a direct $\mathrm{P-P}$ bond, with the structure $(\mathrm{HO})_2\mathrm{P(O)-P(O)(OH)_2}$.
